meaning: `N_v = 1` is the default exponent in the vessel resistance-evolution law (dR/dV family) for every element built by this constructor. At 1 the resistance varies with the lowest power of volume the law allows, so any element that does not override it gets the weakest nonlinear resistance response.

could_move.what: All elements constructed without an explicit N_v inherit exponent 1, changing R(V) and hence flow/pressure waveforms
Read together with activate_resistance_evolution; if that flag stays 1 the exponent is live, not inert
Many downstream element definitions reuse this constructor
Jugular compression comparison figures across m1/m4/m5
h-sweep and postural decks feeding the CIS report
Patient fits, since resistance shape trades off against fitted compliance parameters

expectation: Unknown in magnitude. Direction: a larger N_v makes resistance change more steeply with volume, so compression and collapse responses would sharpen. Whether any element actually relies on this default is not visible in the given context.

check.why: Re-verifies one existing fit instead of re-fitting, so a changed default exponent shows up as a mismatch in that single case.
